name: revealwhy
description: Ask Claude why your website isn't converting. CRO audits, funnel drop-off, ignored CTAs, attention and content engagement, A/B test verdicts and AI-agent traffic — grounded in real visitor behaviour, with evidence and honest confidence.

api_key.title: RevealWhy API key
api_key.description: Scoped read-only key (starts with rw_). RevealWhy → Project settings → API keys, scopes read:analytics + read:findings.

project_id.title: RevealWhy project ID
project_id.description: Default project for every tool (RevealWhy → Project settings → General). Tools can still take projectId explicitly.
